text.Build Overview:
Slam Warrior is one of the strongest leveling builds for league start in PoE 2. The build has amazing clear and single-target damage. It is also very tanky and can clear the campaign quickly with self-found gear.

## Ascendancy
Titan is one of the most powerful Ascendancies in the game, thanks to [Hulking Form|passive-ascendancywarrior1notable5], which massively increases the offensive and defensive bonuses you gain from the passive tree. 
For the rest of your Ascendancy, [Earthbreaker|passive-ascendancywarrior1notable1] stacks with your other sources of Aftershock chance and can scale up to 100%, effectively doubling your damage. Once in maps, you can spec into [Ancestral Empowerment|passive-ascendancywarrior1notable2]. This bonus works with [Fist of War III|fistofwarsupportplayerthree], overriding the 14-second cooldown and granting enormous increases to damage and AoE.

## Breaking Armour
You can break armour on enemies by heavy stunning them thanks to [Shattering Blow|passive-stun17]. This bonus scales with sources of Break Increased Armour and can apply Fully Broken Armour to all enemies (even bosses), granting 20% more damage against them. It also synergizes with [The Molten One's Gift|passive-armour-break16-] to grant increased fire damage against enemies with Fully Broken Armour.

## How to Clear Zones (Act 1):
Cast [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer], then use [Boneshatter|boneshatterplayer] immediately after the first [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer] hit to quickly kill packs of enemies. Mastering this quick combo is key to smoothly clearing Act 1.
You can use [Pounce|wolfpounceplayer] to move through zones quickly, just be sure to grab a Talisman.

## How to Clear Zones (Act 2):
Replacing [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer] with [Leap Slam|leapslamplayer] makes pulling off the [Boneshatter|boneshatterplayer] combo even easier. 
As a bonus, [Leap Slam|leapslamplayer] helps with mobility while also dealing damage!
You can continue using [Pounce|wolfpounceplayer] and Wolf Form to quickly run through areas.

## How to Clear Zones (Act 3+):
Switching from [Leap Slam|leapslamplayer] to [Stampede|stampedeplayer] gives more consistent damage and is safer when moving quickly through campaign zones. You can still use the [Stampede|stampedeplayer]-[Boneshatter|boneshatterplayer] combo, but most enemies will be dead after you've hit them with [Stampede|stampedeplayer].
You should still keep [Leap Slam|leapslamplayer] socketed and use it to jump over terrain.

## How to Kill Bosses (Acts 1 & 2):
Cast [Earthquake|earthquakeplayer] under bosses and refresh it each time it expires. You can hit them with [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer] or [Mace Strike|melee2hmaceplayer] until they are primed for a Heavy Stun, then use [Boneshatter|boneshatterplayer] and attack them with both hits of [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer] (the second hit does more damage to Heavy Stunned enemies).
Once you unlock [Leap Slam|leapslamplayer] in Act 2 and support it with [Crater|supportcraterplayer], you can use it against bosses to cover the area in fissures, then cast [Rolling Slam|rollingslamplayer] to trigger them for massive damage. 

## How to Kill Bosses (Act 3+):
Throw [Forge Hammer|forgehammerplayer] at bosses, detonate it with [Infernal Cry|infernalcryplayer], and stomp around the area with [Stampede|stampedeplayer]. Once the boss is in Heavy Stun range, hit them with [Boneshatter|boneshatterplayer], then cast [Hammer of the Gods|hammerofthegodsplayer]. Boom.
You can add [Sunder|sunderplayer] to the [Hammer of the Gods|hammerofthegodsplayer] combo for even more burst damage.

## Lineage Supports:
You don't need [Rakiata's Flow|supportrakiatasflowplayer] to make [Forge Hammer|forgehammerplayer] blast bosses, but it is a nice flex if you can afford it. If not, [Fire Penetration II|supportfirepenetrationplayertwo] will work until you can.
Socketing [Zerphi's Infamy|supportzerphislegacyplayer] into [Hammer of the Gods|hammerofthegodsplayer] increases the Glory requirement to 50, but allows ALL life costs to generate Glory, letting you freely cast [Hammer of the Gods|hammerofthegodsplayer] without having to heavy stun bosses!
The gem [Atalui's Bloodletting|supportataluibloodlettingplayer] grants Extra Damage as Physical based on life costs. It can be useful as a support for [Stampede|stampedeplayer] if you don't feel that you need the life regeneration from [Holy Descent|supportholydescentplayer].

## Act Bonuses:
- Act 2: Charm Charges Gained
- Act 3: Stun Threshold
- Act 4: Life Flask
- Act 4: +5 Resistances
- Act 4 Shark Fin: 30% Inc Armour/Evasion/ES
- Intermissions: 15% Global Defences

## Amulet Anoint
[Acceleration|passive-movement-speed9] is the best option available.

text.Act1 Equipment desc: Do not worry about gear during the campaign. Get a 2-handed mace with as much physical damage as possible, then smash everything.
text.Act1 Skill Gems desc:
You can cast Boneshatter immediately after the first hit of Rolling Slam to quickly 1-2 combo packs of enemies.
Perfect Strike nukes bosses in Act 1.
text.Act2 Skill Gems desc: Leap Slam will make quick work of enemies and makes the Boneshatter combo even easier. Perfect Strike gets phased out during Act 2.
text.Act3 Skill Gems desc:
Stampede does what Leap Slam does, but better.
Forge Hammer & Hammer of the Gods deal a ton of damage to bosses.
text.Endgame Skill Gems desc: Rakiata's Flow is optional. Fire Penetration works well on a much lower budget.
